trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is nothing to do for this one directly: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then side stories and cleanup — and the Platinum arrives on its own at the end, about 200 hours in by PowerPyx's estimate.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Follow the three roadmap stages so nothing is left for the end.
The Platinum unlocks automatically once the last trophy pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission of Chapter 1, so this pops very early just for playing the story. Nothing to prepare and nothing can be missed — finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
steps: Start the story and play through Gone Fishing.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this pops as the chapter closes. Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the one thing in the chapter that may not come back. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter until the trophy pops.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's missions.
Do Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 as a safety net.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens in this chapter, after the Breakfast Run mission, so use the new freedom to start the side activities that feed later trophies — fishing, the shooting ranges and vehicle scanning all count toward the 100% checklist later.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's missions.
Once switching opens after Breakfast Run, try the side activities as they appear.
Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. This is where the robbery tools start arriving — the Snap Gun for jewelry stores and the street-racing strand — so it is worth doing the optional jobs as they appear rather than rushing the story missions. One race in Yago's strand is time-sensitive, so take it the moment it shows up.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's missions.
Do the optional robbery and racing jobs as they appear.
Take the Race Against Yago as soon as it appears — it is time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. The bank-vault jobs open near the end of this chapter through an optional mission, so look out for it before moving on — the vaults feed both Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist, and escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's missions.
Watch for the optional mission that opens bank-vault robberies near the end of the chapter.
Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission and this Gold pops. Before you start it, make a manual save you never overwrite — there is no mission replay, and that save is your way back if you want to replay the ending or mop up anything tied to the late story. After the credits the open world stays open, so nothing else is lost.
steps: Make a manual save just before the final mission and keep it untouched.
Play and finish the final mission.
After the credits, keep playing in free-roam for the rest of the list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It matters beyond its own trophy: character switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it, which unlocks the partner trophies and most of the free-roam activities, so treat it as the moment the map opens up.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears in Chapter 2.
Finish the mission.
After it, try switching characters — the partner and free-roam trophies open from here.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is an unmissable story trophy — play the mission through to its end and it pops. The heist is also good practice for the robbery trophies later, since the same habits (bring your partner, plan the escape) pay off there.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Like the other mission trophies it pops on completion, so there is no extra condition to meet — just play the mission when the story brings it to you.
steps: Play the story until Child's Play appears.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It pops on completion with no extra condition, so just play the mission when it comes up in the story.
steps: Play the story until Headliners appears.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops on completion. The airport setting is worth remembering: the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can also happens at VCIA, so you will be back here later with a stolen airliner.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops on completion with no extra condition — play the mission when the story brings it to you.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy, but the checklist is forgiving: it is closer to 60% of true completion, and work done during the story already counts. You need 70 of the 80 Challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicle models scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied — partial credit everywhere, so skip the hardest bits. Do the story first, then work the checklist in free-roam.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist.
Work through it in free-roam: challenges, stunts, vehicle scans, animal studies, collectibles.
Use the partial thresholds — 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles — and skip the hardest ones.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida. Stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, so the total climbs naturally if you drive and fly boldly between missions. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 rather than stopping at the trophy.
steps: Attempt stunt jumps and bridge flights whenever you travel.
Mix in base jumps and knife-edge flights — every stunt type counts.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once — the shooting range, fishing, drone races, arcade games, bowling, racing, gym training, hunting and the other open-world pastimes the game offers. You do not need to be good at any of them; one attempt each is enough. It pops as soon as the last type is tried, so it is an easy early trophy if you sample everything as it unlocks.
steps: As each activity unlocks, try it once.
Work through the 9 types: range, fishing, drone races, arcade, bowling, racing, gym, hunting and the rest.
The trophy pops when the last type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Win a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across two shooting ranges. The medals are not punishing — take your time, aim carefully, and replay any challenge that falls short. This is a long grind rather than a hard one, so chip away at a few challenges between story missions instead of doing all 42 in one sitting.
steps: Visit both shooting ranges as they unlock.
Play each challenge and aim for gold; replay any that fall short.
All 42 gold medals earn the trophy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. There are 42 races in total across those locations, but only one win per location counts, so you can ignore the rest. Learn each course's line before pushing for the win, and come back later if a location gives you trouble — the races stay open after the story.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races at each of the 14 locations.
Win at least one race at every location.
The trophy pops on the 14th location's win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street races, off-road races and the other race types all count, as long as each win is a race you have not won before. Yago's street-racing strand is a good place to start, but remember its Race Against Yago is time-sensitive, so take that one the moment it appears. The 20 wins build up naturally if you race whenever the chance comes.
steps: Enter races whenever they appear — street, off-road and others all count.
Win 20 different ones; repeat wins of the same race do not count.
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears, since it is time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types for Master of None, so you will already know the basics by the time you meet him. Take your time with the catch — a steady hand beats rushing — and the trophy pops when you win the challenge.
steps: Learn fishing as an activity first.
Find Cal and take his fishing challenge.
Beat his catch to win the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four in-game arcade games from start to finish. Pick whichever you enjoy most — they are all short — and play it through to the end. This also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade with the four in-game games.
Pick one and play it through to the end.
The trophy pops when the game is completed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's stranger-mission strand to its final mission and finish it. The side-story finales all stay open after the credits, so there is no rush — but note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which has its own trophy, so do it for its own sake.
steps: Find Andy's stranger missions and play through the strand.
Finish the final mission for Andy.
It stays available after the story, so do it whenever you like.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's stranger-mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Like the other side-story finales it stays open after the credits, so you can do it at any point once it appears.
steps: Find Kenton's stranger missions and play through the strand.
Finish the final mission for Kenton.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's stranger-mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so this trophy stands on its own — and it stays open after the credits, so there is no deadline.
steps: Find Billy's stranger missions and play through the strand.
Finish the final mission for Billy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Not every optional questline counts — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count here — so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see which ones moved it. Work through the stranger missions as they appear across Leonida and the Silver pops on the eighth qualifying strand.
steps: Play stranger mission strands as they appear across Leonida.
Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not count.
Finish 8 qualifying strands for the Silver.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's stranger-mission strand to its final mission and finish it. It stays open after the credits, so do it whenever the strand appears.
steps: Find Randy's stranger missions and play through the strand.
Finish the final mission for Randy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's stranger-mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so this is its own trophy — and it stays open after the credits.
steps: Find Tyrone's stranger missions and play through the strand.
Finish the final mission for Tyrone.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida's 10 meditation locations — and this is the one trophy you can miss. The first meditation happens in Chapter 1, on the balcony of Jason's house: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (the morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time) and follow her out to the balcony. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both Jason and Lucia, so bring your partner every time. Do the Chapter 1 one anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
steps: In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
After that, meditate at every purple-icon spot across Leonida's 10 locations.
Bring your partner each time — a spot should count for both characters.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret Vogel's hunting questline — Jason-only — and take down the unique animal he asks for. The hunts run through target decks, and a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what you want. The strand stays open after the story, so there is no rush.
steps: Find Bret's hunting questline (Jason only) and work through its target decks.
Hunt the unique animal he asks for.
Aim for a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find collectible cards across Leonida and complete 3 full sets. Cards are scattered through the world, so pick them up whenever you pass one rather than leaving them all for the end — and keep a note of which sets are close to complete so you know what to look for. The cards also feed the 100% checklist, so the hunting overlaps nicely.
steps: Pick up collectible cards whenever you find them across Leonida.
Track which sets are nearly complete.
Complete 3 full sets for the Silver.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan things at 100 different locations. Scanning a vehicle also counts as discovering it for Whip It Good, so the two trophies build together — scan traffic as you drive and the total climbs fast. PowerPyx lists this among the longest grinds on the road to the Platinum, so make scanning a habit from early on rather than a chore at the end.
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan things at new locations as you travel.
Scan vehicles too — each one also counts toward Whip It Good.
Reach 100 locations for the Silver.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the game's 80 Challenges, listed under Progress, then Challenges. Many complete on their own while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80 — so this trophy arrives on the way there. Skip the hardest challenges; with 30 to spare, there is no need to force any single one.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see all 80.
Complete any 50 — many will finish on their own during normal play.
Skip the hardest ones; keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose the police and escape the red heat zone completely. The easiest way is a bank-vault job: vaults give you 4 stars straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this at the same time as Maximum Withdrawal. The trophy only pops once you have left the heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
steps: Call your partner to join you.
Get a 4-star wanted level — a bank-vault job does it at once.
Escape until you are fully out of the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. The chain breaks if the stars fade and you are left only in the red heat zone, so keep moving and do not stop to hide between shops. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.
steps: Call your partner to join you.
Rob a shop, then two more in a row, while the wanted level stays up.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop for the trophy to pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — the habit also feeds You WAiNKer!. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100 and this trophy arrives on the way to that bigger total.
steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you drive.
Discover 100 different models for the trophy.
Keep going to 200 of 277 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim you trigger by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of enemies bunched together — the guards at an illegal operation are a good target — and use an assault rifle so each shot counts. Adrenaline extends your Focus, giving you more time to line up all five.
steps: Find a group of enemies bunched together, such as guards at an illegal operation.
Aim and press L3 and R3 to trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before the Focus ends — adrenaline extends it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport and take off with it. Planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count — the ones at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off, then fly about a kilometre away from the airport; the trophy is delayed and pops once you are clear. Save first, because the police come fast.
steps: Save first, then go to VCIA and find a passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work).
Get into the cockpit, back out to the runway and take off.
Fly about 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino — and drive it until the trophy pops. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far south-west of the map. Save first, then get in, drive and fire until it pops; expect the army to object.
steps: Save first, then head to Mile Zero Air Station in the far south-west.
Find a Rhino tank parked on the south side of the base.
Get in and drive and fire until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone spotting you. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry-store robberies: go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it, since kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target — and if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
steps: Play Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked back door — do not kick it in.
Find the safe-code note in the back room, open the safe and leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner — and since a vault job gives you a 4-star wanted level at once, escaping with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so keep going past five.
steps: Play That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4 to unlock vaults.
Bring your partner — one person cannot carry all the bags.
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time; keep going to all 8 for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Watch for armored trucks on the road, hit one, take what it carries and get clear of the police — the trophy pops once you have escaped, so the getaway matters as much as the robbery. It pairs well with the vault jobs, since tailing a security van is how the vaults open up.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it and take what it carries.
Escape the police completely for the trophy to pop.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal all 52 areas of Leonida on the map. Drive and fly through every region — the state is big, so explore as you travel for other trophies rather than treating it as a separate chore. The trophy pops once the last area is revealed.
steps: Travel through every region of Leonida by road and air.
Watch the map fill in as areas are revealed.
Explore all 52 areas for the trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are the gang-run fronts scattered across Leonida — hit one per gang and the trophy pops. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this trophy arrives on the way to that bigger total if you keep robbing them as you find them.
steps: Find illegal operations run by the gangs across Leonida.
Rob one operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Keep going to all 39 operations for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. The description points to Ocean Beach — a cocktail with a view — so the trigger is most likely a specific spot or moment there, but no launch-week guide (PowerPyx, Output Lag, KeenGamer, GTA Zone) has pinned it down, and this guide will not invent a method. Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach in free-roam, and check back once players have reported a confirmed trigger.
steps: No confirmed method yet — do not chase a guessed trigger.
If you are on Ocean Beach anyway, try the beachfront bars and look for a cocktail prompt — but do not grind for it.
Check the sources above for updates once players confirm the trigger.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. The description suggests driving a car out through a vehicle showroom's front in the style of the classic GTA introductions, but no launch-week guide has pinned down which showroom or what exactly triggers it, and this guide will not invent a method. Check the sources below for updates once players have reported a confirmed trigger.
steps: No confirmed method yet — do not chase a guessed trigger.
Check the sources above for updates once players confirm the trigger.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This one is tied to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, which is Kingpin Bowling — an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs: take all three key valuables, the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb, then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates alley, in Chapter 2 — bring Sticky Bombs.
Take the luxury watch, the shotgun and the office safe's contents.
Escape the police; the operation returns later if you miss a valuable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you — the shared workouts build both characters' Strength at once. Keep training together until both are at the top, and the trophy should follow. It is still early guidance, so treat the exact trigger as reported rather than certain.
steps: Buy a gym membership.
Train at the gym with your partner — they train alongside you.
Build both characters to maximum Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — robberies, fights and other crimes all feed it, so the counter fills up without a separate grind if you play the game the way the story asks. There is nothing special to do for it: keep playing, keep the crimes coming, and check the counter on your profile to see how close you are.
steps: Play the story and side content normally — crimes feed the counter.
Robberies and fights count toward the 500 actions.
Check your Criminal Profile counter to track progress.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second try at something, but no launch-week guide has pinned down what that something is, and this guide will not invent a method. Check the sources below for updates once players have reported a confirmed trigger.
steps: No confirmed method yet — do not chase a guessed trigger.
Check the sources above for updates once players confirm the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet. The description reads like a reaction to something strange — most likely a rare random encounter somewhere in Leonida — but no launch-week guide has pinned down what it is, and this guide will not invent a method. Play normally, keep an eye out for odd encounters, and check the sources below once players confirm the trigger.
steps: No confirmed method yet — do not chase a guessed trigger.
Keep playing and watch for strange encounters in free-roam.
Check the sources above for updates once players confirm the trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: At launch no published guide has confirmed exactly how this one pops. The description gives the shape of it: bowl people over with a melee drive-by — a melee attack made from a moving vehicle. The sensible try is a slow pass in a car with a melee weapon ready, swinging at a group on foot. It may well pop while you play normally, so do not grind for it until a method is confirmed — check the sources for updates.
steps: No confirmed method yet — do not chase a guessed trigger.
The likely try: a slow pass in a car, swinging a melee weapon at a group on foot.
Check the sources above for updates once players confirm the trigger.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash from robberies — bank vaults pay well, and shop robberies bring in steady money — and your contacts clean them for you. Keep the robberies and the laundering going side by side, and the trophy pops once $250,000 has been laundered in total.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies — bank vaults and shops pay well.
Launder the bills through your contacts.
The trophy pops once $250,000 has been laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the shops of Leonida. Clothes, weapons, food, ammunition and gear all count, so the total builds up naturally as you play — and if you are close to the mark, a round of shopping for outfits and weapon upgrades will finish it off. The trophy pops once your combined spending across all shops reaches $100,000.
steps: Shop across Leonida — clothes, weapons, food and gear all count.
Track your total spending; it builds up naturally during normal play.
Top it up with outfits or weapon upgrades once you are close to $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages go on sale as you explore the state, and robbery income plus laundered cash make the purchases comfortable by the late game. All eight garages are also part of the 100% checklist, so this trophy and the checklist move together.
steps: Find garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Buy them as your money grows — robbery income helps.
Purchase all 8 for the trophy; it also counts toward 100%.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, pick a vehicle you have access to and register it — then repeat with nine more. Any vehicles you drive regularly are good candidates, so work through your favourites and the trophy pops on the tenth registration.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone.
Register a vehicle you have access to.
Register 10 vehicles in total for the trophy.
